concept: Oppenheimer meets Awwwards - Moody, authoritative, and motion-heavy. A cinematic experience blending deep obsidian space with warm amber lighting to symbolize both the creative spark and structured compliance.

layout.spacing: Generous. Use py-24 or py-32 for sections to give cinematic breathing room.
layout.grid: Bento-style Tetris grids for 'Services' and 'Packages'. Asymmetrical spanning.

components.button: Solid primary color for main CTA, heavy padding (px-8 py-4), rounded-full for cinematic feel, with a subtle glow effect on hover.
components.card: Glassmorphic or solid surface with 1px border. Deep background, high-contrast text, hover state lifts up slightly with an amber glow.
components.navigation: Sticky, crystal glass effect. `backdrop-blur-xl bg-black/60 border-b border-white/5`

animations.scrolling: Lenis smooth scroll is MANDATORY for the movie-like feel.
animations.reveals: Framer Motion. Use slow y-axis fades (y: 40, opacity: 0 -> y: 0, opacity: 1) with ease: [0.16, 1, 0.3, 1], duration: 1.2.
animations.parallax: Apply useScroll and useTransform to hero images and abstract backgrounds to move slightly slower than the user scrolls.
animations.hover: Scale up images by 1.05 with a 0.6s ease-out transition. Subtle text color shifts.

hero_background.description: Cinematic abstract background, deep obsidian black with subtle amber volumetric lighting

compliance_abstract.description: Glowing golden geometric structure, representing compliance and structure

design_abstract.description: Vibrant glowing neon ink swirling in deep dark water, representing creativity

business_meeting.description: Cinematic business meeting, good for About section

creative_workspace.description: Creative workspace with digital tablet, for graphic design/marketing section

office_environment.description: Modern open-plan office, useful for team or general agency shots

instructions_to_main_agent: Use framer-motion heavily for cinematic text reveals (split text into words and stagger them in) and scroll-triggered fade ups.
Apply `data-testid` to all interactive elements (links, buttons, form inputs).
Install and use `@phosphor-icons/react` or `lucide-react` for premium iconography.
Implement Lenis smooth scrolling for the entire site.
Do NOT use pure black (#000000). Use `#050505` for the main background to keep it premium.
For the hero section overlay, use `bg-black/40` or a gradient fade `bg-gradient-to-t from-[#050505] to-transparent` so the background image blends perfectly into the next section.
Use standard semantic HTML elements combined with Tailwind, do not overly rely on Shadcn layout components like Card for marketing sections to retain layout freedom.
Keep typography fluid and tightly tracked on headings. Cabinet Grotesk should look monolithic.
Ensure the .js files (like tailwind.config.js and src/index.css) are updated correctly.
